checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  IsCompact E →
    ∀ (s δ : ℝ),
      0 < s →
        0 < δ →
          ∃ k U, E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧ (∀ (i : Fin k), Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) ∧ ∑ i, Metric.ediam (U i) ^ s < ∞
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
